messages.text: No I have a miner on order with you Shop···· but also have a few other smaller bitcoin/ltc miners

Got it, that's the GekkoScience KBOX (22 TH/s) plus the Harlo OS diagnostics pack, paid, heading to (address hidden), and it ships September 30.

One correction to what you were told: the B30 ships October 30, not November 30. $899, about 30 TH/s at 360 to 450 W, and at (address hidden) power rates it's the strongest sats-per-watt step up we sell.

Your LTC units aren't really comparable on dollars per TH, they earn on a different coin, so I'd judge those on power draw instead.

What are you running now?
I’ll take a look at the b30 , thanks
Before you go, one thing: what made you settle on the KBOX when you ordered, rather than shopping around first?
I seen good reviews online , hope I’ve made the right choice 🙏🏼

Good reviews are a fair reason, and the KBOX earns them.

Where did the reviews come from, and what did they say that sold you?
Mainly reliability as the Canaan miners I have all but 2 are broken , sending for repair

That tracks with what we hear about the Canaan units, which is why we don't push the Avalon line.

What went on them, was it the boards, the PSUs, or the fans?

Thanks, that's useful to know.

Your KBOX ships September 30, and the tracking mail goes to this address, so keep an eye out for it. If you do decide on the B30 later, ping me here and I'll sort it.
Any time. Enjoy the KBOX when it lands.
